Line Cook – Full Time
Ember & Oak Restaurant · Portland, OR

We're a wood-fired restaurant serving 250 covers a night. We're looking for a line cook to join our kitchen.

You'll work grill, sauté or garde manger, prep for service and keep your station clean and organized.

Requirements:
- 1+ year experience as a line cook in a high-volume kitchen
- Valid Oregon food handler certification
- Solid knife skills
- Thrives in a fast-paced environment
- Available evenings and weekends

Bonus points:
- Culinary school graduate
- ServSafe Manager certification

What we offer: $21–$24/hr plus share of tips, staff meals every shift, health insurance after 60 days, paid time off, 50% dining discount.

Ember & Oak is an equal opportunity employer. Email chef Dana Wu at kitchen@emberandoak.example
